Male young adult Koala Trevor.  Generally heard at least once a week for the following 12 months.  Not heard since February 2012, and may have moved.

Resident male adult Koala, named Ronald the Koala (see his page on Facebook).  Wandered into back yard barely able to see with conjuntivitis and chlamydia.  Was kindly taken by carers to Aust Zoo Wildlife Hospital and sunsequently released approx 7 weeks later.Is usually visible or audible (bellowing) most weeks within 100-150m of location, although did go missing for a couple of weeks recently.
Koala Joey sitting in tree and then climbed to ground past peole and into bushland behind.
